title: Compose a contrasting riff-driven Big Beat score
description: Create and render a third Big Beat score that is materially different from the two chant-driven Big Beat scores: use a melodic or riff-driven hook and a distinct arrangement.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built Tin Can Thunder: 125 BPM ragtime-piano Big Beat built from chopped and full one-bar ragtime drummer riff, deliberately distinct from the chant-driven scores. Main audition measured objective_v2 104.49. Final local render is in renders/tin-can-final.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Closed in the 2026-10-17 work-in-progress review: Ryan confirmed this score work is done.
